\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Direct speech-to-speech translation with discrete units}\cite{Lee2022DirectSpeechToSpeech}:

Trains an end-to-end model that emits discrete speech units without an intermediate text representation.

\item \textbf{Large-scale Self- and Semi-Supervised learning for speech translation}\cite{Wang2021LargeScaleSA}:

Combines self-supervised pre-training with semi-supervised fine-tuning for speech translation at scale.

\item \textbf{On Fairness in Machine Translation}\cite{Schoettler2023FairnessMT}:

Position paper on fairness metrics for MT systems by Schoettler.
